battlecards.why_selected: Provided lowest total landed cost through HPG tier pricing, agreed to 12-month price freeze and dedicated implementation resources covering all APDerm sites.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year distributor agreement; non-pharmaceutical pricing held firm first 12 months then mutually-agreed for next 12; HPG primary GPO with Premier as secondary.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to shift complete $1.8M volume and benchmark GPO tiers created strong price pressure during multi-round RFP.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Broad dermatology formulary, next-day delivery to New England clinics, robust online ordering & reporting.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Some niche items sourced via third parties; outbound freight charges on ice-pack shipments.
battlecards.switching_costs: Clinic staff training on new ordering portal, formulary alignment, EDI integration.
battlecards.notes: Agreement executed 30-Jul-2021; Treya to monitor any pricing discrepancies against contract.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Could not meet target pricing levels or 12-month price freeze; unwilling to migrate APDerm to higher GPO tier.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Threat of full volume move to alternate distributor.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher pricing, limited GPO alignment, slower response on bid rounds.

battlecards.why_selected: Best value on high-volume northern MA/NH routes; committed to on-time performance SLAs and fuel-surcharge cap.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year master services agreement; fixed route pricing with annual CPI cap; 30-day termination for cause.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Detailed stop-level volume data and willingness to split award created competitive tension among bidders.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Medical courier expertise, HIPAA compliant chain of custody, real-time tracking portal.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Limited southern MA coverage (addressed via split award).
battlecards.switching_costs: Route re-mapping, clinic staff communication, specimen bag re-labelling.

battlecards.why_selected: Strong coverage for southern MA & RI clinics and ability to accommodate STAT pickups.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year agreement; fixed stop charges and mileage bands; 2-year fuel surcharge freeze.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Awarded only portion of business which kept pressure on rates.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher base rates than Miller on long-haul routes.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal – parallel go-live with route testing.
complexity_reasons: Split award as part of competitive RFP

battlecards.why_selected: Matched full 33-site coverage, accepted lower blended hourly rate ($26.60) and agreed to reduce labour hours 10% within 3 months.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year agreement effective 1-Jun-2022; rate locked; growth incentive – first month free for new sites; Net-30 terms.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Alves Cleaning BAFO was 61% lower; threat of switch compelled Enterprise to meet target.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Existing site knowledge, responsive management, ability to scale.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Initial rates above market until negotiations.
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-badging current cleaners and avoiding service disruption weighed in decision.
battlecards.notes: Treya to monitor hour-reduction compliance in first quarter.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Offered greatest savings but could only cover 27 of 33 sites and raised concerns on staffing depth.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Used as competitive pressure in BAFO round.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Lowest hourly rate, flexible contract terms.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Coverage gaps, less sophisticated quality program.
battlecards.switching_costs: Would require dual supplier management for 6 sites.
complexity_reasons: Participated in RFP, provided lowest bid but not awarded

battlecards.why_selected: Provided single-invoice managed service with SLA monitoring and 38% reduction in MRCs.
battlecards.contract_terms: 36-month master services agreement; pass-through carrier charges plus fixed management fee; early termination aligned to carrier terms.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Aggregated 30+ circuit accounts and threatened to move to alternate aggregator.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Lifecycle management, proactive outage notifications, TEM portal.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Relies on underlying carriers for last-mile remediation.
battlecards.switching_costs: Carrier change orders and porting; minimal user impact.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Standalone circuit pricing uncompetitive versus aggregator model; limited SLA transparency.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to disconnect or convert circuits through OneSource.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Extensive coax footprint, rapid install on new sites.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Fragmented billing, high contract renewal uplifts.
battlecards.switching_costs: Circuit cancellation charges (absorbed in savings model).

battlecards.why_selected: Offered deepest discounts on standard Dell & Lenovo builds, local stocking, and imaging services.
battlecards.contract_terms: 2-year preferred reseller MOU; core configuration pricing held 12 months; next-day delivery for stocked items.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Committed volume forecast of $400K+ and competitive quote spread.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Regional service presence, flexible financing, asset tagging.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Smaller national footprint compared to CDW.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal – change in order portal and invoicing.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Could not match 25%+ discount level or provide free imaging; higher freight charges.

battlecards.why_selected: Agreed to 0.30%-0.35% rate reduction (to 1.50% on first $150M collections) and 3-year price lock with quarterly true-up, avoiding costly platform migration.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year services agreement; revenue share tiered 1.50% / 1.45% / 1.40%; quarterly look-back; cosmetics revenue excluded.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Executed full RFP, highlighted $250M revenue growth projection and switching intent.
battlecards.supplier_strengths: Integrated PM/EHR platform, proven collections performance, scalable with acquisitions.
battlecards.supplier_weaknesses: Higher base rate than niche RCM providers; add-on fees for patient statements.
battlecards.switching_costs: High – data migration, provider retraining, interface rebuilds.
